mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.amount), 0) FROM edu_stock_in doc JOIN edu_stock_in_item item ON doc.in_id = item.in_id WHERE doc.status = '1' AND doc.del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(doc.in_time, '%Y-%m') = #{month}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(item.quantity * COALESCE( (SELECT price FROM edu_stock_in_item WHERE goods_id = item.goods_id ORDER BY item_id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) ), 0) FROM edu_stock_out doc JOIN edu_stock_out_item item ON doc.out_id = item.out_id WHERE doc.status = '1' AND doc.del_flag = '0' AND DATE_FORMAT(doc.out_time, '%Y-%m') = #{month}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(g.stock_num * COALESCE( (SELECT price FROM edu_stock_in_item WHERE goods_id = g.goods_id ORDER BY item_id DESC LIMIT 1), 0) ), 0) FROM edu_goods g WHERE g.del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM edu_goods WHERE del_flag = '0' AND stock_num < warn_low

SELECT category, CASE category WHEN '1' THEN '教师办公品' WHEN '2' THEN '学生教材' WHEN '3' THEN '文印耗材' ELSE '其他' END AS name, COALESCE(SUM(stock_num), 0) AS stockNum, COUNT(goods_id) AS goodsCount FROM edu_goods WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
